candidates.economic_rationale: Volume-weighted momentum breakout: 1h close breaks above 24h rolling VWAP by > 0.5 * 1h ATR with volume surge (> 1.5x 20h SMA) and strong signed taker flow (> 0.15). Symmetrical short for break below VWAP.
candidates.falsification_criteria: Volume surge leads to immediate liquidity exhaustion and reversal under 44 bp stress.

candidates.economic_rationale: Regime transition from consolidation to directional expansion: 4h ADX(14) was below 18 for >= 3 bars (chop) and crosses above 20 with DI directional confirmation and 1h 12-hour high/low breakout.
candidates.falsification_criteria: Chop exit signals produce false starts that quickly collapse back into range.

candidates.economic_rationale: Cumulative Volume Delta (CVD) momentum confirmation: 12h price breakout accompanied by simultaneous new 12h high in cumulative taker buy volume delta, verifying aggressive buying dominance.
candidates.falsification_criteria: Aggressive CVD surges fail to sustain drift and suffer negative net returns under stress fees.

candidates.economic_rationale: Trend continuation on shallow pullbacks: In a 4h structural trend (EMA20 > EMA50 and close > EMA20), enter on a 15m pullback touching the 20-bar 1h Donchian midline when 15m close recovers with positive flow (> 0.10).
candidates.falsification_criteria: Midline pullbacks break through into deep trend reversals, hitting stop losses.

candidates.economic_rationale: Calibrated volatility expansion: 1h ATR compression (< 0.85 of 56-bar ATR) followed by 1h expansion (> 1.2x SMA10) with volume confirmation (> 1.5x) and 15m taker flow confirmation.

math_formulation.short_entry: (min(1h_ATR14/1h_ATR56 in prior 12h) < 0.85) and (1h_ATR14 > 1.20 * 1h_ATR14_SMA10) and (1h_vol > 1.5 * 1h_vol_SMA20) and (1h_close < 1h_low_20) and (15m_signed_taker_ratio < -0.10)

candidates.economic_rationale: Liquidity sweep exhaustion into trend: In 4h uptrend (EMA20 > EMA50), a temporary sharp sell-off occurs with 15m signed taker ratio < -0.30 and long lower wick (rejection), entering on the next 15m bar with positive flow (> 0.10). Symmetrical short for buying climax into downtrend.

math_formulation.long_entry: (4h_EMA20 > 4h_EMA50) and (prev 15m: flow < -0.30 and lower_wick > 2 * upper_wick) and (current 15m: close > prev_close and flow > 0.10)
math_formulation.short_entry: (4h_EMA20 < 4h_EMA50) and (prev 15m: flow > 0.30 and upper_wick > 2 * lower_wick) and (current 15m: close < prev_close and flow < -0.10)

candidates.falsification_criteria: Counter-trend momentum continues through stop loss, failing to revert to higher timeframe trend.
